answer: Every operator posts a pulse bond of 200,000 POA, doubling for each further identity, so the fifth demands 3,200,000 POA in the beacon registry. A jetty check at epoch end compares activity across identities; when two share one operator, the operator's whole bond burns and rewards pass to honest peers. One fake risks its bond plus a 258,000 POA reward; five fakes put 6,200,000 POA in bonds and 1,290,000 POA in rewards at stake, all burning on detection.
